```yaml
name: Release Py

permissions:
  contents: read
  id-token: write

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'py/**'
      - '.github/workflows/release-py.yml'

concurrency:
  group: release-py
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    name: Release Python Packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository_owner == 'moq-dev'

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv pip install --system --requirement py/requirements.txt

      - name: Release packages
        run: |
          chmod +x py/common/release.sh
          py/common/release.sh
        env:
          PYPI_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.PYPI_API_TOKEN }}
```
